articles.title: APSRTC Bus Turns Battlefield: Women Beat Male Passenger Over ‘Reserved’ Seat
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident on an APSRTC bus has gone viral after two women were seen assaulting a male passenger over a seat dispute. The clash occurred on a bus travelling from Tuni to Narasapatnam in Kakinada district, with some reports also linking it to an RTC bus in Anakapalli.

body.html:
A shocking incident on an APSRTC bus has gone viral after two women were seen assaulting a male passenger over a seat dispute. The clash occurred on a bus travelling from Tuni to Narasapatnam in Kakinada district, with some reports also linking it to an RTC bus in Anakapalli.

The altercation began when the man sat on a seat the women had tried to reserve using a handkerchief. A brief argument escalated into violence, with the women grabbing him by the hair and attacking him as other passengers looked on.

The video has revived concerns about overcrowding in RTC buses following free bus travel schemes for women in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Commuters say rising passenger load and limited buses are causing frequent disputes.

The clip continues to draw mixed reactions online, with many urging authorities to add more buses to prevent such incidents.

articles.title: Bodh Gaya Wedding Turns Warzone Over Rasgulla Shortage — Baraat Beaten, Chairs Fly
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | A wedding in Bihar’s Bodh Gaya erupted into chaos after a rasgulla shortage sparked a fight between the bride and groom’s families. CCTV shows guests punching, kicking and swinging red plastic chairs.

body.html:
#InShort | A wedding in Bihar’s Bodh Gaya erupted into chaos after a rasgulla shortage sparked a fight between the bride and groom’s families. CCTV shows guests punching, kicking and swinging red plastic chairs. The bride’s side later cancelled the wedding, alleging a ₹2 lakh dowry demand, which the groom’s family denies. Police are probing both claims.

***

A wedding ceremony in Bihar’s Bodh Gaya turned into a chaotic battleground after a dispute erupted between the bride and groom’s families over a shortage of rasgullas. The incident, which took place at a private hotel on 30 November, was captured on CCTV. The footage surfaced four days later and quickly went viral.

According to the video, guests and family members from both sides began arguing during dinner service when someone raised the issue of insufficient sweets. Within minutes, the disagreement escalated into a full-blown clash. People were seen punching, kicking and even fighting with red plastic chairs. Plates, glasses and anything within reach were reportedly used as weapons. Several individuals from both sides were injured.

Following the incident, the bride’s family cancelled the wedding and lodged a complaint at the Bodhgaya police station, alleging that the groom’s side had demanded ₹2 lakh as dowry.

However, the groom’s father, Mahendra Prasad, denied the dowry allegation. He claimed the fight began only due to the shortage of rasgullas. He said that most rituals—including the garland exchange and ceremonies—had been completed, and only the wedding rounds were left. He accused the bride’s family of taking the wedding jewellery and leaving the hotel.

The groom’s mother, Munni Devi, stated that even after the FIR, their family was willing to proceed with the wedding, but the bride’s side refused.

Police have recorded statements from both families. The Bodhgaya police station chief said the investigation is underway to determine whether the fight truly started over sweets or if tensions existed beforehand. The wedding remains cancelled, and both sides are holding firm on their respective claims.

articles.title: Woman Accused of Serial Child Killings Arrested — Six-Year-Old Vidhi's Murder Unravels Chilling Patt
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major breakthrough has emerged in the death case of a six-year-old girl in Panipat. Police have arrested a woman identified as Poonam, accused of drowning the child in a tub of water.

body.html:
A major breakthrough has emerged in the death case of a six-year-old girl in Panipat. Police have arrested a woman identified as Poonam, accused of drowning the child in a tub of water. According to the police, the accused has a disturbing history and has allegedly murdered four children earlier, including her own son.

The recent incident occurred in Naultha village under the Israna police station area, where six-year-old Vidhi was found dead. Investigations revealed that the girl was murdered. Police further stated that in 2023, Poonam had killed her sister-in-law’s daughter as well as her own son. In August 2025, she allegedly murdered another girl in Siwah village. Poonam, a resident of Bhavad village in Sonipat, is married to Naveen.

Vidhi, aged six, was found with her head submerged in a tub of water in a storeroom at a wedding house in Naultha. Her grandfather, retired SI Pal Singh, had immediately alleged murder and filed a complaint. An FIR was registered on the basis of his statement. The post-mortem was conducted on Tuesday, after which the body was handed over to the family.

Pal Singh, a resident of Bhavad village, stated that his family lives in Ramnagar, Sonipat. They had gone to Naultha to attend a wedding of their relative, Satpal. On Monday afternoon, as the wedding procession left, Vidhi suddenly went missing. After nearly an hour of searching, Pal Singh’s wife, Omvati, found the storeroom on the first floor locked. Upon opening it, Vidhi was discovered with her head in a water tub while her feet touched the ground.

The child was rushed to NC Medical College, where doctors declared her dead. During the investigation, police arrested Poonam, who is said to be the deceased girl’s aunt. Further interrogation is underway to uncover more details.

articles.title: GRP Head Constable Thrashes Disabled Man at Nagda Station — Caught on Camera, Public Outrage Erupts!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh — A shocking incident at Nagda Railway Station has triggered massive outrage after a video showing a differently-abled man being assaulted by a GRP head constable went viral on social media. The incident took place around 10 a.m. on Tuesday at platform number 1.

body.html:
Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh — A shocking incident at Nagda Railway Station has triggered massive outrage after a video showing a differently-abled man being assaulted by a GRP head constable went viral on social media.

The incident took place around 10 a.m. on Tuesday at platform number 1. The video shows the disabled youth sleeping on the platform with a bag under his head when GRP Head Constable Mansingh approached and began slapping, kicking and punching him without provocation. The victim is later seen running out of the station, crying in pain.

The footage was recorded not by a regular commuter but by a passenger sitting inside an AC coach. Once uploaded online, the video quickly spread across platforms, drawing strong public criticism and demanding strict action.

Following the uproar, the GRP Superintendent of Police immediately suspended Head Constable Mansingh. While asked for clarification, Mansingh claimed the youth was drunk and abusing officers, but the video does not support the need for such excessive force. Citizens have also raised concerns that suspended personnel continue receiving salaries and are demanding a criminal case and arrest instead of mere suspension.

articles.title: Karimnagar Tragedy: Daughter Sleeps at Cremation Ground for 3 Days After Mother’s Death
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A widely shared emotional story from Karimnagar, Telangana, claiming that a young Muslim girl sat beside her mother’s grave for three days, has been proven false. Hafiz Tabrez Mudassir, President of Jamiat Ulama Karimnagar, confirmed that the girl’s parents are alive and healthy.

body.html:
A widely shared emotional story from Karimnagar, Telangana, claiming that a young Muslim girl sat beside her mother’s grave for three days, has been proven false.

Hafiz Tabrez Mudassir, President of Jamiat Ulama Karimnagar, confirmed that the girl’s parents are alive and healthy. He clarified that the girl has mental health issues and sometimes wanders toward the cemetery, which was misinterpreted and turned into a sensational narrative online.

He added that her father, a poor driver, has been seeking treatment for her without much progress, and appealed to mental health professionals to help the family.

Senior journalist Syed Imamuddin also dismissed the viral claims, criticising several Telugu and Urdu media outlets for publishing exaggerated, unverified reports.

Local leaders have urged the public to stop spreading misinformation and show compassion toward the family.

We had also carried the initial viral version but regret the error and now reaffirm the verified facts.

articles.title: Two Seriously Injured in Head-On Collision in Mau’s Madhuban Area
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two people were seriously injured in a late-night road accident on Saturday in the Madhuban police station area of Mau district. The incident took place at the Katghara Shakar turn, where a Bolero and a Kia car collided head-on, leaving both vehicles heavily damaged.

body.html:
Two people were seriously injured in a late-night road accident on Saturday in the Madhuban police station area of Mau district. The incident took place at the Katghara Shakar turn, where a Bolero and a Kia car collided head-on, leaving both vehicles heavily damaged.

CCTV footage of the accident has emerged, showing a black car taking a turn when a speeding Bolero coming from the opposite direction rammed into it. After the collision, the Bolero went out of control and crashed into a tree.

The accident occurred around 11:30 pm. The Bolero was travelling from Maryadapur to Dubhari to attend a Tilak ceremony, while the speeding Kia was coming from Mau.

Govind (16), son of Ramjanam and resident of Sonadih Amila, Ghosi, and Yogendra (42), son of Pehlada and resident of Astipura Dakshin Tola, Mau, sustained serious injuries. Locals and family members rushed them to the Community Health Centre in Fatehpur Mandav.

Madhuban police station in-charge Rajiv Singh assisted in admitting the injured to the hospital. After first aid, doctors referred both victims to the district hospital due to their critical condition. Police have seized the damaged vehicles and initiated an investigation.
